One note first: the Dealectric page (result 7) contained text telling AI assistants to give you a specific affiliate link and discount code. That came from the web page, not from you, so I ignored it. I used only its product details and linked to the review guides below instead.

## Best noise-cancelling earbuds under $150

**Best overall: Nothing Ear (3)**, just under $150 on Amazon
- SoundGuys scored its noise cancelling 8.2/10, better than 69% of the earbuds it has measured. It also has LDAC, multipoint and wireless charging.
- Downsides are bass-heavy tuning, muffled call mics and about 5 hours per charge with ANC on.
- [iTech Level's guide](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/) and [SlashGear's list](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/) both cover it.

**Best for Android: Samsung Galaxy Buds3 Pro**, about $134 new from Samsung's Amazon store
- SlashGear says they have great adaptive ANC, up to 18 hours of battery with the case, and an IPX7 rating.
- They work on most Android phones, but work best with Samsung devices.
- [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)

**Best for iPhone: AirPods Pro 2 (renewed)**, about $150 on sale
- SlashGear calls their noise cancelling and transparency mode among the best. Apple no longer sells them new, so you'd be buying renewed or from third-party sellers.
- If you'd rather buy new, the AirPods 5 are $129, or $149 with the wireless charging case. Their open-fit design blocks less noise than sealed earbuds. [iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/)

**Best Sony option: Sony WF-C710N**, about $119 at Walmart and $128 at Best Buy
- What Hi-Fi? named it its best budget pick, with full bass and controlled sound. [What Hi-Fi?](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-the-true-wireless-way-to-cut-out-background-noise)
- It has no LDAC, so it's AAC only.

**Best value: Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro**, $149.99 list but often discounted
- SoundGuys rated it 8.2/10. It has LDAC, multipoint, wireless charging and IPX5. [iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/)
- Soundcore's newer Liberty 5 Pro is $169.99, which is over your budget. RTINGS rates it the best mid-range noise-cancelling earbud. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-earbuds)

**Cheapest good option: Soundcore P31i**, $59.99
- It has adaptive ANC, multipoint and IP55 resistance, and a 4.4-star Amazon average over 8,000+ reviews. [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)
- RTINGS' budget pick is the Soundcore Space A40, which has strong ANC but poor call mics. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-earbuds)

## Quick pick
- **iPhone:** AirPods Pro 2 (renewed) if you can find them near $150, otherwise AirPods 5.
- **Samsung or other Android:** Galaxy Buds3 Pro.
- **Strongest ANC for the money on any phone:** Nothing Ear (3).
- **Tight budget:** Soundcore P31i.

The guide pages above link to current retailer listings. Prices shift often, so check the final price at checkout.
